name: list_chats
title: List chats
description: List the coding-agent chats on the connected computer, most recently active first. Each line gives the chat id, its title, project, agent, status (working, idle, stopped, failed or needs sign-in) and whether it is waiting for an answer from a person. Call this first to find a chat id.

name: list_projects
title: List projects and agents
description: List the projects on the connected computer with their folders, and the coding agents installed there. Use a folder id and an agent id from this list with start_chat.

name: read_chat
title: Read a chat
description: Read the most recent turns of one chat: what was asked, the steps the agent took, its answer, and any request still waiting for an answer (with the request id and the option ids respond_to_request accepts).

turns.description: How many of the latest turns to read. Defaults to 2.

name: send_message
title: Send a message
description: Send a message to a chat's coding agent, as the person at the computer would. It starts a turn, or waits in the chat's queue when the agent is already working. The agent can edit files and run commands on that computer. Follow with wait_for_chat to get the result.

name: wait_for_chat
title: Wait for a chat
description: Wait until a chat's agent finishes its turn or needs an answer, then report its status, its latest answer and any waiting request. Returns after at most timeout_seconds even if the agent is still working; call it again to keep waiting.

timeout_seconds.description: The longest to wait. Defaults to 30.

name: respond_to_request
title: Answer a waiting request
description: Answer a request a chat's agent is waiting on. For a permission request, pass one of its option ids from read_chat (for example to allow or reject a command). Leave option_id out to decline the request or dismiss a question; then send your answer as a message.

option_id.description: The chosen option's id. Leave it out to decline or dismiss.

name: stop_chat
title: Stop a turn
description: Stop the turn a chat's agent is working on. The chat and its history stay; the agent stops what it was doing.

name: start_chat
title: Start a chat
description: Start a new chat with a coding agent in one of a project's folders and send its first message. Returns the new chat's id. Follow with wait_for_chat to get the result.

agent_id.description: An agent id from list_projects. Leave it out to use the project's usual agent.

name: create_project
title: Create a project
description: Make a new project on the connected computer from a folder that already exists there. Returns the project's id and its folder id, which start_chat takes. An agent started in that folder can read and change the files in it, so use the folder the person named.

path.description: The folder's full path on the computer.

name.description: The project's name. Leave it out to use the folder's name.

name: chat_options
title: Show a chat's options
description: List the models, thinking levels and access levels a chat offers, with the current choice of each marked. Call this before set_model, set_thinking or set_access.

name: set_model
title: Choose a chat's model
description: Change the model a chat's agent uses, to one of the values chat_options lists. It applies from the next message.

name: set_thinking
title: Choose a chat's thinking level
description: Change how much a chat's agent thinks before answering, to one of the levels chat_options lists.

name: set_access
title: Choose a chat's access level
description: Change what a chat's agent may do without asking: ask (it asks before editing or running commands), auto_edit (it edits files and asks before commands) or full_auto (it works without asking). Use the level the person asked for.

name: switch_agent
title: Hand a chat to another agent
description: Continue a chat with a different coding agent. The chat's agent is stopped and the conversation so far is handed to the new one. Returns the chat id to use from then on; the next send_message carries the handoff.

name: rename_chat
title: Rename a chat
description: Give a chat a new title.

name: archive_chat
title: Archive a chat
description: Move a chat out of the list of open chats, or bring it back with archived false. Nothing is deleted.

archived.description: false restores it. Defaults to true.

name: start_agent
title: Start a stopped chat's agent
description: Start the agent of a chat that is stopped, without sending a message.

name: list_changes
title: List a chat's changed files
description: List the files a chat's last turn added, modified or deleted.

name: read_change
title: Read one changed file
description: Show one file from list_changes as it was before the chat's last turn and as it is after. Only files that turn changed can be read.

name: read_memory
title: Read a project's memory
description: Read the notes every chat in a project starts with.

name: write_memory
title: Replace a project's memory
description: Replace the notes every chat in a project starts with. Send the whole new text (read_memory first, then change it), at most 4 KiB. It is refused when the owner has turned off edits to project memory.

markdown.description: The complete new notes, as Markdown.
